report.summary: No blocking findings. The CI cache pruning is guarded: it prunes only when CI_CHECKS_OK is true, the run wrote new entries and every Turbo run summary can be read; otherwise it removes nothing. The save step now depends on prune.outputs.changed. A failed run saves every entry. deploy-worker.ts now always builds, verifies and pins the image digest. It fails if the build id is missing from the image's tempod, so a stale Turbo-cached tempod build is caught too (TEMPO_BUILD_ID is part of the task hash). tempod's VERSION now uses dot access, which matches `bun build --env=TEMPO_BUILD_*`. Every RPC name and input shape in the forge demo matches packages/protocol/src/api.ts, and the expected PR_NOT_MERGEABLE when reopening a merged PR matches apps/tempo/src/artifacts/pull-requests.ts and 09 'Merged PRs cannot reopen'. Docs were updated in the same change (CI.md, IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES, CORE-TEST-DEPLOYMENT). Caveat: node_modules is not installed in this worktree, so I could not run bun typecheck, lint or tests, or read the installed Turbo docs. The notes below are not blocking.

findings.text: Deadline enforcement now depends on Bun 1.4.2 honouring `detached: true` (setsid). If Bun ignored the option, `process.kill(-pid, ...)` would fail with ESRCH, the empty catch would swallow it, and the 300 s timer would no longer kill the check (before, child.kill killed at least the direct child). Confirm with `bun run typecheck` (SpawnOptions typing) and a CI run where one check passes its deadline.

evidence.quote: const timer = setTimeout(() => killGroup(child.pid, "SIGTERM"), Math.max(0, remaining));
evidence.why: killGroup swallows every error, so if the child is not a process-group leader the deadline kill silently does nothing.

findings.text: Detecting changes by mtime assumes actions/cache keeps archive mtimes on extract, which GNU tar does by default, and that Turbo never rewrites restored entries. If either assumption fails, `changed` would be true on every run. That only causes extra saves; no entries are lost.

evidence.quote: const changed = files.some((file) => statSync(path.join(cacheDir, file)).mtimeMs > since);
evidence.why: Correctness depends on the timestamps that the restore step leaves on extracted files. Only fail-safe behaviour was observed here; it was not verified on a runner.

findings.text: `test:e2e` runs every spec, so each live e2e run now also runs this hour-long demo. Each run creates a new `tempo-demo-<tag>` repository that is never deleted, and that adds up on the test deployment. Consider excluding this file from the default e2e config.

evidence.why: The README says the repository is deliberately left in place, and the default `playwright test` matches this file too.

findings.text: The tests cover only the pure helpers. The main block (marker mtime comparison, the CI_CHECKS_OK gate, rmSync, GITHUB_OUTPUT) has no test.

checked.risk: Real contracts (GitHub Actions cache, Turbo run summary and local cache layout, Bun spawn/build --env, Docker CLI, Tempo RPC API)
Failure paths (prune fails closed on bad summaries or failed checks; deploy fails if build id missing; group kill errors swallowed)
Idempotency and state (cache save per run key, marker after restore, failed runs keep all entries)
Security (CA mounted only as a BuildKit secret, no new secrets in logs or env)
Build and runtime environment (grep available in image, tempod path, TEMPO_BUILD_ID in Turbo task hash, Effect 4 Schema API)
Tests (no sleeps; waitFor polls observable CI state; unit tests assert outcomes; scripts tests picked up by scripts/test.ts)
Spec (PR_NOT_MERGEABLE for merged PR and gate, native merge methods, CI doc rules, implementation notes)

args.command: git rev-parse HEAD && sed -n 1,100p .github/workflows/ci.yml && cat scripts/ci.ts | head -60 && grep -n "buildId\|TEMPO_BUILD_ID" scripts/deploy-worker.ts | head -20 && grep -rn "TEMPO_BUILD_ID\|--env" packages/tempod/package.json container/Dockerfile | head; grep -n "tempod\|grep" container/Dockerfile | head -20

cat turbo.json | head -80; grep -rn "noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature" tsconfig*.json packages/tempod/tsconfig.json; grep -rn "process.env\.[A-Z]" packages/tempod/src | head -5; grep -n "ci-cache\|scripts/" scripts/test.ts | head; ls node_modules/turbo* -d 2>/dev/null; node -p "require('turbo/package.json').version" 2>/dev/null
grep -n '"turbo"' package.json bun.lock | head -3; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i turbo; ls node_modules | grep -i turbo

grep -n '"effect"' package.json bun.lock | head -5; grep -rln "fromJsonString" --include=*.ts packages apps scripts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "decodeUnknownOption" --include=*.ts packages scripts | head -3; ls ~/.bun/install/cache 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(turbo|effect)" | head

for n in createRepository getRepository updateCiPipeline listCiRuns getCiRun getCiJobLog getRepositoryPullRequest listCheckRuns mergePullRequest updateRepositoryPullRequest listRepositoryCommits createPullRequest; do printf "%s " $n; grep -rlw "$n" packages/protocol/src | wc -l; done; grep -rn "PR_NOT_MERGEABLE" docs/*.md | head -8
